final.questionTranslation: toi co the dat mot bai mat xa duoc khong

greeting.text: Hello, thank you for your message, and our therapists come right to you where you are staying.
greeting.translation: Xin chao, cam on tin nhan cua ban, va cac ky thuat vien cua chung toi se den tan noi ban dang o.

answer.text: Which massage would you like, and you can see all of them on the website {website}?
answer.translation: Ban muon chon bai mat xa nao, va ban co the xem tat ca tren trang web {website}?

closing.text: I am here to answer all your questions and to make your booking easy.
closing.translation: Toi o day de tra loi moi thac mac va giup ban dat lich de dang.
